note: The seasonal alternative is in hoc potíssimum. At w004 the prose setting on p. 291 prints iustem. Benziger’s sung setting on p. 236 and the Vatican prose setting on p. 288 both print the selected iustum. The witness header records the printing error. The Vatican prose omits the comma after destrúxit, and both printings have Angelis where the selected text supplies the accent in Ángelis.

adjudicated.ruling: The comma printed in the controlling approved Benziger setting is retained; the comparison setting omits it without changing the words.
The lexical accent on the capital is supplied under the house orthography; both printed readings are preserved in the transcriptions.
